package.name: b166er_vision
package.description: Visual perception for b166er servoing. Rectifies the T265 fisheye stream (Kannala-Brandt model) into a virtual pinhole image and detects AprilTag (36h11) fiducials, publishing tag pose and TF for the Fuzzy whole-body visual servoing loop (no depth camera: the T265 is the only RealSense on the robot).
